context: Prior A+B/A-only/B-only evidence was already observed; all stage3 TRAIN frames are previously seen data, not new heldout evidence

primary_metric.comparison: Exact same complete larger-five TRAIN frame and matched external pair

selection: K2 scalar is eligible only when its direct K0-to-K2-scalar compatible whole-CPre comparison passes the improvement guard
K2 SIMD is eligible only when its direct K0-to-K2-SIMD compatible whole-CPre comparison passes the improvement guard
Select eligible K2 SIMD only when the direct K2-scalar-to-K2-SIMD compatible whole-CPre comparison also passes the same improvement guard for its added complexity
Otherwise select eligible K2 scalar; if neither filtered choice meets these conditions retain K0

conditional_larger_followup.purpose: Directly assess the selected candidate against both defaults; no transitive timing inference

standard_followup.always: legacy-before-vs-after on the complete standard TRAIN cohort
standard_followup.selected_KD: Selected KD versus optimized ranked default on the complete standard TRAIN cohort
standard_followup.if_no_filter_qualifies: plain K0 versus optimized ranked default
standard_followup.freeze: Actual source/map/spec-bound plans fixed and reviewed before any standard-tier execution

preservation: Retain every constructor/rebuild metric, native-width observation, unfavorable outcome and censor; selection uses only the stated compatible whole-CPre guard
no_other_tuning: No K1, axis, cutoff, leaf-size, cap, scoring, trace or rerun tuning; additional work needs root coordination
limitations: This fixed threshold is an engineering choice for exploratory seen-TRAIN selection, not a significance test, population noise estimate, solver-speedup proof or backend-switch decision
